# Altitude design system

> Lit 3 web components + React wrappers, monorepo, evolving via a gate-driven
> v2 refactor described in NEXT-GEN-UPGRADE-PLAN.md.

## Read first

- [Refactor plan](/NEXT-GEN-UPGRADE-PLAN.md): authoritative spec for every
  active task (T0.x through T6.x), guardrails (G1–G8), gates (P0–P6).
- [Agent contract](/AGENTS.md): authoring rules, where things live, how to
  verify changes.
- [Migration manifest](/.altitude/migration.json): per-component state.
  `legacy` components are read-only outside migration PRs (G2, CI-enforced).
- [Pinned targets](/.altitude/targets.json): committed end-state versions
  (React 19, Vite, SD v5, pnpm, Lit 3.3, Storybook 10).

## Subsystem docs

- [Token engine](/.altitude/TOKENS.md): SD v3 + v5 parallel pipeline,
  byte-comparable CSS output. Tokens are DTCG.
- [Build pipeline](/.altitude/BUILD.md): webpack + Vite parallel, with the
  SCSS-import rewrite plugin that bridges both.
- [Semver policy](/.altitude/SEMVER.md): semver + migration-state interaction.
- [Baselines](/.altitude/baselines/README.md): VRT screenshots, token snapshot,
  bundle size — the truth-set every change must move with (G8).

## Source of truth for consumers

- [Custom Elements Manifest](/libs/al-web-components/custom-elements.json):
  generated by `@custom-elements-manifest/analyzer`. Coverage gated by
  `scripts/check-cem-coverage.js`.
- [Token name union](/libs/al-web-components/styles/dist-v5/tokens.d.ts):
  TypeScript types for every `--al-*` name (generated).
- [Frozen alias map](/libs/al-web-components/styles/dist-v5/aliases.json):
  identity map at T1.1; deprecation budget 3.0.0.

## Pilot components (the 5 that prove every new pattern, G3)

- button (`libs/al-web-components/components/button/`)
- input (`libs/al-web-components/components/input/`)
- select (`libs/al-web-components/components/select/`)
- dialog (`libs/al-web-components/components/dialog/`)
- theme-switcher (`libs/al-web-components/components/theme-switcher/`)
